status: PLACEHOLDER: fill every null from the paper (the figure or table of GaAs sigma^xyz, with the scissors and broadening it used) before the anchor is used
source: J. Ibanez-Azpiroz, S. S. Tsirkin and I. Souza, Phys. Rev. B 97, 245143 (2018)
eta_definition: PyATB's eta: the Gaussian exp(-(x/eta)^2)/(eta sqrt(pi)); convert the paper's broadening to it
notes: peak_eV and height_uA_V2 are the published extremum of sigma^xyz (signed, microA/V^2); convention_factor is -1 if the paper's sign convention is opposite to QUEER's (carrier charge -e, sigma^abc(0; w, -w)); window_eV optionally limits the photon energies searched
